title: Ogun Meeting summons hearth service, works, surroundings ministries over security considerations
text:
The Ogun State House of Assembly has summoned key authorities businesses and ministries over rising public security considerations within the state.

Speaker of the Home, Rt Hon Oludaisi Elemide, issued the invites at plenary on Thursday.
He first summoned the Head of Fire Service and the Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Particular Duties to seem on Friday, October 23, 2026, over the state of fireside stations throughout the state.
The invitation adopted a Matter of Pressing Public Significance raised by Waliu Owode, representing Ijebu East State Constituency, over a latest hearth outbreak at Itele Market that destroyed property and technique of livelihood.
Owode stated residents of his constituency had repeatedly referred to as on the federal government and related businesses for intervention.
In one other invitation, the Speaker summoned the Commissioner for Works and Infrastructure, the Comptroller of Works, FERMA and the contractor dealing with the Abeokuta-Sango-Ota Expressway to seem on Tuesday, October 27, 2026.
This adopted a presentation by Babatunde Tella, representing Abeokuta North, who blamed persistent gridlock alongside the Brewery, Ita-Oshin and Idi-Ori axis on giant roundabouts on the highway.
Tella urged the Home to intervene by decreasing the scale of the roundabouts to ease site visitors circulate, particularly throughout peak durations.
Equally, the Meeting invited the Commissioner for Setting, the Ogun State Environmental Protection Agency and different related businesses to seem on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, over a suspected gaseous leak that led to the hospitalisation of schoolchildren in Ijebu-Ode and its environs.
The invitation adopted a report by Lukman Adeleye, representing Odogbolu State Constituency, who famous that comparable incidents had beforehand been reported within the space.
Whereas commending the businesses for managing previous incidents, Adeleye stated they wanted to transient lawmakers on measures to forestall future occurrences and areas the place legislative assist was required.
